content: Gains with forward translation are significant, as in BIBREF21 , albeit about half as good as with BT, and result in small improvements for the in-domain and for the out-of-domain tests. Experiments combining forward and backward translation (backfwdtrans-nmt), each using a half of the available artificial data, do not outperform the best BT results.
